items: The minimal BOUNDED human-in-the-loop atom: an intake distills the single decision, a person answers (or the hold expires into the defer default), a capture lane applies the released answer as data
Timer default != a result: the deferred release writes nothing and the record stays parked — the lane cannot mistake silence for a ruling
The hold-vs-wall law is baked in: the capture seat's own timeout equals the gate's hold ceiling, so no consumer can die mid-collection (and the day cap marks the longest legal armed hold)
